compute_farfield_profile: compute a farfield profile from flux, wavelength, and in-plane wavevector arrays using the FMM scheme
compute_propagation_angles: compute polar and azimuthal propagation angles from unflattened transverse wavevectors and a free-space wavelength
compute_solid_angle: compute the solid angle associated with each transverse wavevector on the unit sphere
compute_integrated_flux: compute the integrated flux within angular bounds defined by a custom angle bounds function
unflatten_fourier_array: unflatten a Fourier expansion array for a given expansion and Brillouin zone integration scheme
